unpriced_assets.detail: HEG's demerger has ex-date and record date 2026-09-07, entitling one resulting company share per HEG share per the company filing. The resulting company has no price anywhere in this repository -- the market cache ends 2026-08-21. Excluded from marked value rather than valued at zero: booking the full quote drop as a loss would assert the entitlement is worthless, which no evidence here supports.

note: Marks come from the research market cache, whose last session is earlier than the books' own live marks. These figures are therefore a like-for-like comparison against the benchmark at one common date, NOT a restatement of either book's live valuation.
